metadata.description: Marketplace of Claude Code / Cowork plugins for legal corpora — one plugin per U.S. state plus three shared federal reference plugins (us-federal-debt-corpus, us-federal-immigration-corpus, us-federal-legal-corpus). Each plugin ships verbatim reference corpora for legal research and document production. Currently 53 plugins total: 50 state + 3 federal. Per-plugin detail lives in each plugin's README.md.

plugins.name: us-federal-debt-corpus
plugins.description: Shared federal reference plugin: canonical FDCPA / FCRA / TILA / ECOA / Reg B-Z + RESPA / SCRA / FHA / FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule, the Title 11 Bankruptcy Code, and the model UCC (a dependency of every state plugin, dereferenced from in-tree symlinks at install time), plus a nationwide FCRA consumer credit-report-rights skills layer. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-federal-immigration-corpus
plugins.description: Shared U.S. immigration-law plugin: INA (8 U.S.C. ch. 12), 8 CFR + 22 CFR, and the Foreign Affairs Manual mirrored verbatim, plus an EOIR court-rules corpus; an on-demand case-law index for the federal circuits, the Board of Immigration Appeals, and the USCIS AAO; and an 11-skill, venue-independent, document-producing self-help layer. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-wa-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Washington court documents: GR 14 formatting; King / Pierce / Snohomish / Spokane venues + family-law department + county roll-up; six subject bundles (consumer-debt, family-law, landlord-tenant, personal-injury, employment, commercial-disputes) plus a matter-neutral CPA/UDAP skill (Consumer Protection Act, RCW 19.86 — Hangman Ridge) and a CEMA (RCW 19.190 anti-spam; Brown v. Old Navy) skill. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-or-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Oregon court documents: UTCR 2.010 formatting; Multnomah + Washington County Circuit Court + county roll-up; ORS 697 / Oregon UTPA consumer-debt bundle. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-ca-legal-corpus
plugins.description: California court documents: CRC 2.100-2.119 formatting; LASC + SFSC + county roll-up; Rosenthal Act / FDBPA / CDCLA / UCL consumer-debt bundle. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-co-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Colorado court documents: C.R.C.P. 10 + Chief Justice Directive 11-01 formatting; Denver + Arapahoe + county roll-up; consumer-debt and UDMA family-law bundles. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-in-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Indiana court documents: Ind. Trial R. 5(E) formatting; Marion + Lake + county roll-up; consumer-debt and family-law bundles (Jarboe summary-judgment standard, T.R. 59 motion-to-correct-error quirk). Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-ny-legal-corpus
plugins.description: New York court documents: 22 NYCRR § 202.5 / § 202.5-b NYSCEF formatting; five flagship Supreme Court venues plus District / City / Justice / Family / Housing courts; five subject bundles (consumer-debt, landlord-tenant, personal-injury, employment, commercial-disputes). Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-oh-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Ohio court documents: Ohio Civ. R. 10 + per-court local rules; eight Court of Common Pleas venues + municipal-courts + family-court; CSPA consumer-debt and family-law bundles. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-tn-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Tennessee court documents: Tenn. R. Civ. P. 10/11 + local-rule formatting; Circuit / Chancery / General Sessions; Davidson / Shelby / Knox / Hamilton venues + General Sessions + split family/juvenile; four subject bundles. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-mi-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Michigan court documents: MCR 1.109 / 2.113 formatting; Wayne + Oakland Circuit + 36th District + family division; six subject bundles. Full detail in the plugin README.

plugins.name: us-az-legal-corpus
plugins.description: Arizona court documents: Ariz. R. Civ. P. 10 / 7.1 formatting; Maricopa + Pima Superior + Justice Courts + family department; six subject bundles. Full detail in the plugin README.
